name: Natsumi
source:
The number two cast member at the club, Natsumi has a strong personality and speaks her mind, which makes her well-liked by many. Being the second favorite, she has a natural rivalry with Sumiya, though the exact intensity of their contest tends to depend on which side of Sumiya is in control.
With her necklace on, Natsumi and Sumiya are fierce competitors that often engage in trash talk and taunting. Without it, though, Natsumi is much kinder to her competition, knowing when to pull her punches (most of the time). Even then, she can’t help but feel some sense of jealousy.
Being as popular as she is, Natsumi has many regular customers that she consciously must keep at a distance lest the darker, more obsessive side of her personality results in her becoming too attached.
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250128235727/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.chabakura]Google Play[/url]]
